meta.name: ad-campaign-analyzer
meta.description: Analyze ad campaign performance data (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) to identify what's working, what's wasting budget, and specific cut/scale/test recommendations. Runs statistical analysis, funnel diagnostics, and multi-channel budget reallocation with specific dollar-amount shift recommendations and scenario modeling.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析广告效果，找出浪费预算并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在管理多平台广告并想提升ROI
copy.tagline_en: Analyze ad performance, identify waste, and get optimization recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multi-platform ads and want to improve ROI

howto.what: 分析广告活动数据（Google、Meta、LinkedIn），找出浪费预算的地方、表现好的广告，并给出具体的暂停、加投、测试建议，以及跨渠道预算重新分配方案。
howto.when: 当你提供广告数据（CSV、粘贴表格或截图），并说出“分析我的广告活动”、“哪些广告应该暂停”、“预算怎么分配”等类似请求时触发。

say.text: 分析我的Google Ads数据，告诉我哪里浪费了钱。
say.note: 技能会读取数据并生成浪费报告。

say.text: 我每月广告预算1万美元，怎么分配在Google和Meta上？
say.note: 技能会基于效率排名给出分配建议。

say.text: 检查一下我的Meta广告哪个表现最好，哪个该停掉。
say.note: 技能会识别赢家并推荐暂停项。

howto.what_en: Analyzes ad campaign data (Google, Meta, LinkedIn) to identify waste, winners, and provides specific pause/scale/test recommendations plus cross-channel budget reallocation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide campaign data (CSV, paste, or screenshot) and say phrases like 'analyze my ad campaign', 'which ads should I pause', or 'how should I allocate my budget'.

say_en.text: Analyze my Google Ads data and tell me where I'm wasting money.
say_en.note: Skill reads data and generates waste report.

say_en.text: I have $10k/month ad budget, how should I split between Google and Meta?
say_en.note: Skill gives allocation based on efficiency ranking.

say_en.text: Check my Meta ads, which one is best and which should I kill?
say_en.note: Skill identifies winners and recommends pauses.
